content:
Pitru Paksha (also called Shradha Paksha, Mahalaya Paksha, or Pitri Paksha) is a 16-lunar-day period in Hindu tradition during which Hindus perform rituals to pay homage to deceased ancestors (Pitrs), especially through food offerings (Pinda) and water libations (Tarpan).

In 2026, Pitru Paksha begins on **Purnima Shradh (Full Moon day)** and concludes on **Sarvapitri Amavasya (New Moon day)** — the most powerful day of the entire cycle when Shradh can be performed for all departed ancestors regardless of their death tithi.

### 2026 Pitru Paksha Dates (Tentative — Jyotish Confirmation Pending)
| Date | Tithi | Shradh For |
|---|---|---|
| 29 September 2026 | Purnima | Those who died on Purnima |
| 30 September 2026 | Pratipada | First day departed |
| 1 October 2026 | Dwitiya | Second day departed |
| ... | ... | ... |
| 13 October 2026 | Chaturdashi | Accidental death / warriors |
| 14 October 2026 | **Sarvapitri Amavasya** | **ALL ancestors** |

### Why Gaya During Pitru Paksha is Exceptional
Gaya Kshetra's sanctity multiplies during Pitru Paksha. Lakhs of pilgrims arrive from across India and the Hindu diaspora globally. Gayawal Purohits conduct continuous Pinda ceremonies across all 45 sacred Dhaams simultaneously.

sections.heading: What To Avoid During Pitru Paksha
sections.body: Non-vegetarian food, alcohol, auspicious events (weddings, housewarming), purchasing new items, and cutting hair/nails should be avoided during the Pitru Paksha fortnight.

sections.heading: Why Book Early for Pitru Paksha in Gaya
sections.body: Hotels within 5km of Vishnupad Temple sell out 3-4 months in advance during Pitru Paksha. Gayawal Purohit slots are also limited — Pitraya Rituals secures verified, hereditary Purohits as part of every package.

faqs.question: What is Sarvapitri Amavasya?
faqs.answer: Sarvapitri Amavasya (Mahalaya Amavasya) is the last and most important day of Pitru Paksha when Shradh can be offered to all ancestors regardless of their death date. It is considered the most powerful day for ancestral liberation rites.

faqs.question: Can Pitru Paksha Pind Daan be done in absentia by a proxy?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pitraya Rituals offers video-witnessed proxy Pind Daan for families unable to travel, where the designated Gayawal Purohit performs the complete ceremony with live video documentation.
